Andy Burnham Delivers Speech on Policy Proposals

Andy Burnham delivered a speech at the Labour conference outlining policy proposals on pensions, social care, and electoral reform. He stated a willingness to discuss previously avoided topics. Separately, a pie shop owner received a reply from Burnham regarding high street closures after posting a social media video. In another instance, prisoners reportedly praised Burnham as they were freed early from jail. The Prime Minister's office issued a statement after Burnham was criticized for 'backing' Manchester City owners. There was also discussion regarding Burnham's stance on rejoining the EU and his consistency on this plan.
